hypothesis.statement: On a real eyes-closed posterior EEG channel (eegmmidb S002R02, POz), the newly-authored dispersionEntropy reproduces NeuroKit2 entropy_dispersion BIT-FOR-BIT for BOTH the dispersion entropy (DispEn) and the reverse dispersion entropy (RDEn) across (c, dimension, delay) settings; the signal realizes only a fraction of the c^m possible dispersion patterns; and DispEn lies below the normalization ceiling 1/ln(2) implied by NeuroKit2's base-2/natural-log convention.

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: dispersionEntropy equals NeuroKit2 entropy_dispersion to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9) for both DispEn and RDEn across settings
